metadata.description: Name of the Azure Automation account that runs the Exchange Online configuration collector.
Display name shown in Microsoft Sentinel workbooks to identify the collected Exchange Online environment. If the value does not end with '-cloud', the deployment appends '-cloud' automatically.
Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID) to audit and use for Azure Monitor log ingestion.
Logs ingestion endpoint URI of the Azure Monitor data collection endpoint.
Immutable ID of the data collection rule used in Logs Ingestion API requests, for example dcr-00000000000000000000000000000000.
Name of the existing Azure Monitor data collection rule in this resource group, used to grant the collector permission to ingest logs.
Azure region where the Automation account and its child resources are deployed.
Base URI that hosts the PowerShell module packages imported into the Automation account.
Unique GUID for the Automation job schedule association. A new value is generated automatically for each deployment.
